# toast — edge-hub: toast of shingo-edge/www/static/js/shingoedge.js
# a fresh page per case; nothing in the page markup holds a toast container.

toast("Saved", "success"): returns, and the DOM it writes: returns undefined
    div class="toast-container"
      div class="toast toast-success"
        "Saved"
level (none): the toast node:
    div class="toast toast-info"
      "Msg"
level "info": the toast node:
    div class="toast toast-info"
      "Msg"
level "success": the toast node:
    div class="toast toast-success"
      "Msg"
level "warning": the toast node:
    div class="toast toast-warning"
      "Msg"
level "error": the toast node:
    div class="toast toast-error"
      "Msg"
level "bogus": the toast node:
    div class="toast toast-bogus"
      "Msg"
lifetime, level (none): transparent at 3000 ms, removed at 3300 ms
lifetime, level "success": transparent at 3000 ms, removed at 3300 ms
lifetime, level "warning": transparent at 3000 ms, removed at 3300 ms
lifetime, level "error": transparent at 3000 ms, removed at 3300 ms
lifetime, level "bogus": transparent at 3000 ms, removed at 3300 ms
lifetime, "error", {sticky:false}: transparent at 3000 ms, removed at 3300 ms
{sticky:true}, "error": the node, after 60 s, then a click on it: gone within 60 s (sticky ignored), so no click
    div class="toast toast-error"
      "Msg"
three toasts: the container's children, in order: "one" toast toast-info | "two" toast toast-error | "three" toast toast-success (1 child(ren) of body)
twelve toasts at once: how many are in the DOM: 12 toasts, first "n0"
message with markup <img src=x onerror=alert(1)> & "q": the toast's children:
    div class="toast toast-error"
      "<img src=x onerror=alert(1)> & \"q\""
toast(null): ""
toast(42): "42"
toast(an Error("boom")): "TypeError: boom"
toast({error:"x"}): "[object Object]"
